verdict.rationale: Persona's docs show inquiries can be pre-created via the API, polled for status, and queried for specific verification details, with verification resources such as selfie and government ID documented in the API reference and webhooks providing status updates. Nothing in the evidence shows retrieving captured media or cancelling or redacting an inquiry through the API. missing for 10: API retrieval of captured media/files, cancel/expire endpoint, redaction endpoint, evidence that every lifecycle step is documented end-to-end, independent/hands-on corroboration
